title: Is fruit sugar bad for you? 🍎
caption:
Whole fruit comes with fiber and water, and the "cut sugar" advice means added sugars, not whole fruit. Studies link more whole fruit to lower risk of type 2 diabetes; juice is different. Fruit fits fine, even when cutting. Favourite fruit? 👇

General information, not medical advice.
